ConsumedBy: terraform/aws.tfvars, the system tagged Function = pdq
Notes: AmazonSSMManagedInstanceCore is REQUIRED, not incidental: the framework supports four connection profiles -- ssh-direct, ssh-ssm, winrm-direct, winrm-ssm -- and the two SSM ones need it. connection_type is a per-system choice in terraform/aws.tfvars, so an instance profile that omits this silently removes half the transports.
